sql-and-iis.note: cmd.exe under sqlservr.exe and commands under w3wp.exe. The initial entry vector is unknown.

stalled.note: bdreinit.exe with log.dll and ask.exe with ask.dll loaded from the same directory. Hand-typed typos are not a detection.

ai-scripts.note: Long PowerShell submitted through the existing shell. Section banners are content, not a process-name signal.

orion-move.note: The second-server command used Orion's bundled erl.exe. Later hive saves came from an EfsPotato payload. The generic payload query does not name either.
